offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 3 (Max Verstappen), the driver of Car 63 (George Russell), team representatives and reviewed video, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. Both cars were approaching Turn 14, with Car 3 ahead of Car 63. Car 3 braked earlier than expected and changed direction under braking. Car 63, approaching from behind, moved to the left and attempted to overtake on the inside. During the manoeuvre, the front axle of Car 63 was ahead of the mirror of Car 3. The two cars subsequently made contact. During the hearing, the drivers also discussed the informal gentlemen's agreements concerning the preparation for a flying lap and the conduct expected between drivers in such situations. The Stewards noted these explanations but considered that such informal understandings were of limited relevance to the assessment of the incident. The decisive considerations were the actual movements of both cars and their relative positions. The Stewards therefore examined the braking and change of direction of Car 3, the evasive manoeuvre and positioning of Car 63 and taking into account the applicable Driving Standards Guidelines. The Stewards considered that Car 3's change of direction under braking was unpredictable and contributed to the situation in which Car 63 had to move to the inside to avoid contact. While the Stewards did not consider the manoeuvre sufficiently serious to warrant a more severe penalty, they concluded that changing direction under braking in these circumstances fell below the standard of driving expected. Taking into account the circumstances of the incident, the Stewards determined that The Stewards a Driver Warning was appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code

title: Infringement Car 3 Erratic Driving In Turn 14
